description: Verifies a plaintext confidential payload against its SHA-256 digest using RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization. Supply the inner payload digest, not the outer on-chain intentHash. Zero gas cost; runs in local memory.

expectedDigest.description: The expected SHA-256 digest of the canonicalized confidential payload (the inner payload digest referenced as digest: sha256:<hash> in actionSummary), not the outer timestamp-salted on-chain intentHash. Accepts raw hex, 0x, or sha256: prefixes.

payload.description: The plaintext contract, agreement, or intent data to be verified.

name: rohan_verify_commitment
